test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In September 2023, after the retirement of Incumbent Sanjay Kumar Mishra, who was appointed as In-charge Director of ED?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rahul Navin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rahul Navin** was appointed as the **In-charge Director of the Enforcement Directorate (ED)** in September 2023.
 
• This appointment followed the retirement of **Sanjay Kumar Mishra**, the incumbent Director of the ED.
 
• **Rahul Navin** was serving as the **Special Director of the ED** before his promotion to the role of In-charge Director.
 
• The **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** is a law enforcement agency under the **Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India**, responsible for enforcing economic laws and fighting financial crimes.
 
• The ED operates under two key legislations: the **Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002**, and the **Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), 1999**.
 
• As In-charge Director, **Rahul Navin** is expected to oversee critical investigations and ensure the smooth functioning of the agency.
 
• He is a **1993-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer** with extensive experience in handling financial crimes and investigations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tushar Mehta**__

 __
 
• **Tushar Mehta** is the **Solicitor General of India**, the second-highest law officer in the country.
 
• He is primarily involved in representing the Government of India in legal matters.
 
 
 
• **Samant Goel**__
 __
 
• **Samant Goel** is the **Chief of the Research and Analysis Wing (RAW)**, India's foreign intelligence agency.
 
• His role is focused on gathering and analyzing external intelligence for national security.
 
 
 
• **TV Somanathan**__
 
 
• **TV Somanathan** is the **Finance Secretary of India**, responsible for overseeing the financial policies of the government.
 
• He is a senior Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer with expertise in public finance and administration.
